questions.stem: Which factor is NOT considered when choosing a promotional mix?
questions.explanation: Company location does not directly influence the promotional mix; instead, factors like target audience, budget, and product type are critical.

distractorRationale.a: Target audience is essential as it determines how to communicate effectively.
distractorRationale.b: Budget is crucial because it limits or expands available promotional options.
distractorRationale.c: Product type affects the choice of promotional tools based on its characteristics.

questions.stem: What is an example of above-the-line promotion?
questions.explanation: Television commercials are considered above-the-line promotion as they reach a mass audience through traditional media.

distractorRationale.a: Direct mail is a form of below-the-line promotion targeting specific individuals.
distractorRationale.b: Personal selling involves direct interaction with customers and is also below-the-line.
distractorRationale.c: Trade shows are typically considered below-the-line as they focus on direct engagement.
